systems.owner: Niger National Police, with INTERPOL; financed by the European Union
systems.tiers: the data centre (DACORE) and 26 police and gendarmerie sites in Niamey connected to it at August 2019; expansion to the regions planned

note: INTERPOL newsletter on the police information system; 'local authorities' refers to officials attending events in Mali, The Gambia and Liberia. The Niger system is the national police's, in Niamey, and no local government office is named.
